subject: Coffee & Tea
title: Can the Industry Fix Itself?
description: A 60-second lesson on Can the Industry Fix Itself?.

hook.text: The coffee industry knows it has a problem. Farmer poverty, climate change, and deforestation threaten its own future.

buildup.text: Major companies have pledged sustainability goals—carbon neutrality, farmer income support, and reforestation.

discovery.text: Progress is real but slow. Only 25% of coffee is currently produced under any sustainability certification.

twist.text: Some argue that consumers ultimately hold the power—by choosing to pay more for transparent, ethical coffee.

climax.text: The question isn't whether coffee can be sustainable. It's whether the change will come fast enough to matter.

punchline.text: The industry that runs on beans now runs against the clock.

quiz.question: What percentage of coffee is currently produced under sustainability certification?
